sources.name: OGC API - Tiles - Part 1: Core 1.0
sources.role: tile-resource discovery, tile-matrix selection and individual-tile retrieval contract
verified_facts: The standard defines Web API building blocks for retrieving tiled vector features, coverages, maps and imagery.
An individual tile is addressed using a tileMatrix identifier together with tileRow and tileCol indexes.
The tileMatrix parameter selects one of the scales defined by the referenced Tile Matrix Set.
semantic_limits: A successful tile response is a tiled subset or representation and is not proof that the complete terrain source was read.
Tile row, column and matrix identifiers do not establish exact HMLR parcel containment.
Media type negotiation and API conformance do not establish numeric height semantics, vertical datum or source accuracy.

sources.name: OGC Two Dimensional Tile Matrix Set and Tile Set Metadata 2.0
sources.role: tile scale, cell size, origin, matrix dimensions and tile-index contract
verified_facts: A tile matrix partitions space into conterminous tiles at a fixed scale, while a Tile Matrix Set collects matrices at different scales in one CRS.
Scale denominator or cell size, point of origin, tile dimensions and matrix dimensions define each tile matrix.
Rescaling or reprojection between incompatible scale sets or CRSs can require resampling and can degrade visual quality.
semantic_limits: Scale denominator and cell size are tiling and portrayal parameters; they are not the native DEM sampling interval or a height-accuracy statement.
A tile boundary or tile index is not an exact cadastral polygon.
A resampled tile must not be treated as full-resolution numeric evidence.

sources.name: OGC GeoPackage Encoding Standard 1.4.0
sources.role: SQLite container, tile-pyramid, zoom-level, pixel-size and extension contract
verified_facts: A GeoPackage is a self-contained SQLite container that may hold vector features, tile matrix sets of imagery or raster maps, attributes and extensions.
The gpkg_tile_matrix metadata describes tile-matrix structure at each zoom level, including pixel sizes and matrix dimensions.
GeoPackage tile pyramids may contain multiple zoom levels and may have unavailable or no-data-padded tiles at matrix edges.
semantic_limits: Core GeoPackage or tile-table conformance does not establish that tile values are elevation measurements.
Zoom level and pixel size metadata do not certify native terrain resolution, vertical datum or measurement accuracy.
Container integrity is distinct from verifying every referenced tile payload and its provenance.

sources.name: OGC API - Maps - Part 1: Core 1.0
sources.role: map portrayal, viewport scaling, response CRS and rendered-bounds contract
verified_facts: A map resource is retrieved as a portrayal using an HTTP GET operation and a successful response identifies its rendered CRS and actual Content-Bbox.
Width and height describe the viewport in pixel units; together with bbox, scale denominator and display resolution they control map scaling.
The server may resample or compute omitted dimensions, and implementations can produce slightly different computed extents unless all controlling parameters are supplied.
semantic_limits: A rendered map image is portrayal output, not a numeric elevation coverage.
Viewport width and height are not proof of the source raster's native sampling resolution.
Content-Bbox describes the rendered map boundary and is not exact HMLR parcel geometry.
